discourse.title: Naamasmarana - The Panacea
discourse.excerpt: It purifies, it cleanses; it elevates; it spreads its fragrance in the atmosphere; it inspires.
discourse.theme: Repeating the Lord's Name transforms — it purifies, cleanses, elevates, and spreads fragrance in the atmosphere.

reflection: Swami says the Name must flow in the mind in an uninterrupted stream: it is not a ritual to be finished but a current to stay in. Today, tie the Name to one routine — your morning walk, your drive, your cooking — and let it run through that hour unbroken. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 7, 26 Nov 1967)

video.title: Chanting to Awakening | Sathya Zadeh's Journey Through Vedas With Sathya Sai

seva_nudge: Keep the Name going through one ordinary task today — repeat it quietly while you cook, clean or commute, and notice how the task itself feels lighter.
